metric.compile_parse_success_rate.note: 9/9 generated files compiled with tsc on first attempt, exit code 0.

metric.correct_at_1.note: 9/9 scenario-A trials passed embedded self-tests on the first generated version with no repair. Scenario B not run.

metric.correct_at_n.note: All 9 scenario-A trials already correct at N=1. Supplementary unseen-case trial (outside primary cell universe) needed 1 repair turn to reach success.

metric.diagnosis_efficiency.note: Model correctly diagnosed and fixed all three flagged TS2367 comparison-type errors in a single round trip using only the raw tsc diagnostic text.

metric.generated_code_compile_performanc.note: 12/13 tsc invocations succeeded with exit code 0 on first attempt; 13th (unseen-case) failed then succeeded after repair. Wall-clock compile timing not separately captured; only success/failure and diagnostic text recorded.

metric.generation_success_rate.note: All 9 specification_to_implementation trials (SVM/GMM/LightGrad x3) produced a syntactically parseable, complete TypeScript source file on the first generation call; reference_to_porting scenario not yet run.

metric.prompt_robustness.note: Three semantically-equivalent prompt phrasings (verbose/polite, terse, reordered-constraints-first) all produced compiling, passing implementations. Diagnostic sample (1 task x 3 variants), not the full Section 22 matrix.

metric.repair_efficiency.note: Repair succeeded in 1 of 3 allowed turns.

metric.repair_success_rate.note: 1/1 observed repair attempt (unseen-case S-expression evaluator, TS2367 errors fed back verbatim) succeeded on first repair turn. Small sample because primary trials required no repair.

metric.silent_bug_resistance.note: Across all 9 successful scenario-A trials, output matched embedded numeric/behavioral oracles; no silent-bug case observed in this sample. Larger adversarial silent-bug probe set not run within budget.

metric.source_token_efficiency.note: Median generated source size recorded per workload; not cross-language normalized in this shard.

metric.specification_compliance.note: All 9 scenario-A outputs implemented exact required function signatures (trainSVM/predict, fitGMM, Value class w/ add/mul/pow/relu/backward) per spec, confirmed via successful compilation against each trial's own self-test call sites plus manual signature review.

metric.syntax_hallucination_resistance.note: Across all 13 observed generations (9 spec + 3 prompt-robustness + 1 unseen-case + its repair), no invented/nonexistent TypeScript syntax or fabricated stdlib API was produced; observed compile failure was a real type-narrowing bug, not hallucinated syntax.

metric.test_pass_rate.note: All embedded numeric/behavioral self-tests passed for all 9 scenario-A trials.

metric.total_token_efficiency.note: TCT approximated by completion character counts (gateway-side token counts not separately exposed to this worker; documented measurement-source limitation). 9/9 primary trials succeeded with zero repair turns (minimal TCT). The one repaired trial added exactly 1 repair round-trip.

metric.unseen_case_generalization.note: Nested S-expression evaluator combining add/mul/neg into forms not shown in given examples. Initial attempt (Correct@1) failed to compile due to unsound union-type comparison; after 1 repair turn using compiler diagnostic, all 4 nested/boundary tests passed. Scored 67 (partial credit: correct@1 failed, correct@N succeeded) on this single-trial diagnostic; too small a sample to substitute for full Section 21 protocol.

evidence.trial_protocol: Each trial_start opened a fresh model session (no shared history) per primary.json fresh_session_per_independent_trial=true. Repairs used trial_continue with the verbatim tsc diagnostic fed back to the model, honoring cross_trial_history_sharing=false and max_repair_turns=3.
